notes: No article morpheme stands in this verse; every 'the' is a supplied determiner placed on the nominal expression it determines (rules 15, 29).
The fronted object leaves the verb's unit discontinuous ('will I scatter' after 'the whole remnant of thee').
'the whole' puts the supplied determiner on כֹּל, before which it stands; placing it on 'remnant' is the competing reading named in that unit.
